changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: B-036 (decisión del dueño del 2026-11-15): el instructor dueño de un curso queda asignado como evaluador al publicarlo y puede sumarse cualquier otro instructor. Se retira el trigger que rechazaba al dueño en course_evaluators y se actualizan las descripciones de la tabla y de la columna.
changeSet.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS course_evaluators_not_owner_trg ON course_evaluators
COMMENT ON TABLE course_evaluators IS 'Instructors assigned as evaluators of a course; the owner is assigned when the course is published (replaces the evaluator role, DEF-24, B-036)'
COMMENT ON COLUMN course_evaluators.user_id IS 'Instructor assigned as evaluator; it can be the course owner'

rollback.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN course_evaluators.user_id IS 'Instructor assigned as evaluator; cannot be the course owner'
COMMENT ON TABLE course_evaluators IS 'Instructors assigned as evaluators of a course without owning it (replaces the evaluator role, DEF-24)'
CREATE TRIGGER course_evaluators_not_owner_trg BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON course_evaluators FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION course_evaluators_check_not_owner()

changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: B-036: asigna como evaluador al dueño de cada curso activo ya publicado (o generando contenido) que no tenga ninguna fila en course_evaluators, siempre que el dueño siga activo con el rol instructor. Es idempotente (NOT EXISTS sobre el par curso-usuario) y solo inserta; assigned_by_user_id es el propio dueño porque la asignación es automática.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO course_evaluators (course_id, user_id, assigned_by_user_id) SELECT c.id, c.owner_user_id, c.owner_user_id FROM courses c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.owner_user_id AND u.active WHERE c.active AND c.status IN ('generating_content', 'published') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = c.owner_user_id AND ur.active AND r.active AND r.code = 'instructor') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM course_evaluators ce WHERE ce.course_id = c.id AND ce.user_id = c.owner_user_id)
